title: The Prognostic Significance of TRs in Hepatocellular Carcinoma: Insights from TCGA and GEO Databases.
reason: Paper reanalyzes public bulk microarray and RNA-seq data for prognostic analysis; no new multi-batch scRNA-seq integration or code provided.
methods_summary: Bulk microarray and RNA-seq expression analysis of THRA/THRB in HCC using TCGA and GEO databases, with scRNA-seq analysis of GSE140228 using Seurat. Functional assays on THRB overexpression in cell lines.
